newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty firms vs basket, 1-day depos slip lower.
newsitem.headline: Zloty firms vs basket, 1-day depos slip lower.

text.p: 1235 GMT - The zloty closed at -1.09/-1.20 pct from parity centre vs Tuesday's -1.90/-2.02 pct after foreign speculators joined a domestic bank-driven currency-selling trend.
* It closed at 3.4360/80 to the dollar, against 3.4536/65 on Tuesday and at 1.8770/05 to the mark, against 1.9010/40.
* Some said an IMF statement saying Polish fundementals were sound despite flooding also gave the zloty a boost.
* O/N close at 22.60/23.10 pct vs 23.55/23.65 pct at opening. T/N at 22.70/23.20 vs Tuesday's 23.65/24.05 pct.
* C.bank rejects all bids at 6-, 14-day reverse repo.
* 91-day NBP-bill yield up to 22.58 pct from 22.50.
